topic: Rebuilding Self-Trust: How to Stop Breaking Promises to Yourself
caption:
Tumhare dimaag ko tum par bharosa nahi raha kyunki tum har baar 'kal se' bolkar bhool jaate ho.

Self-trust ek din mein nahi banta, micro-promises poori karne se banta hai.

Aaj hi ek chota promise chunlo aur usse complete karo.

Aaj tum apne aap se kaun sa 1 chhota promise poora karne wale ho? Comment mein batao 👇
